text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I head to the rooftop to relax on my
break,
when...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Um... I'd like one carrot mouse flappy
beanzo,
please!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ack, that's not right! A carrot
m-m-mousse...
flappy... flappy...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, fiddlesticks! There's no way I'm
gonna be
able t'order in one of those
fancy-pants city
cafes!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
The carrot mousse frappuccino? Isn't
that from
that cafe that's been all the
rage recently?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah! C-City?!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Are you practicing ordering? Why?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ngh... I wanted t'be hip 'n cool like you.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Hm? I mean, that just comes with
experience.
How about... Okay, follow
me.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
The cafe's a little far, but we can walk
around
here today and let you get used
to the vibe.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Me, in the trendy part of town, with
you?!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Trendy part of town? No need to make
such a big
deal out of it. Just be
yourself.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
B-but I'm worried I'm gonna mess up...
Then
ever'body'll know I'm just a country
bumpkin.
Even you...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Country, city, who cares? Would you
laugh at me
if I messed up?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
No way, not in a million years! Ever'body
makes
mistakes... Ah.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
See? There's nothing to be embarrassed
about.
Nothing ventured, nothing
gained, as they say.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Wooow. "Nothing ventured, nothing
gained"! You
city folks sure are great
with words!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Thanks,
City! I feel like I can pull it off!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Good, that's the spirit. Let me know
when you go
to that cafe, and I'll tag
along.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Really?! Great! I won't be scared one bit
if you're
there!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Heh... You give me too much credit.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Gold City laughs quietly as Yukino Bijin

vigorously says "nothing ventured,
nothing
gained" over and over to herself.
